executive_summary: This collection window (January 12-18, 2027) is the thirtieth archived window overall and the last full week before Paris menswear Fall/Winter 2027-2028 (Jan 19-24) and Haute Couture Spring/Summer 2027 (Jan 25-28) begin. Consistent with SKILL.md workflow note 10, the CFDA/Vogue Fashion Fund winner and CFDA Fashion Awards questions were checked briefly rather than re-litigated: fresh search again found no dated announcement resolving either, so both remain 'untracked going forward pending new information' and are not repeated as top signals this window. Discourse this window is genuine pre-show anticipation coverage rather than in-window runway content, since the shows themselves have not started. Multiple editorial and trade sources (WWD, Wikipedia's designer biography entry, and additional outlet coverage) corroborate that Grace Wales Bonner's menswear debut as creative director of Hermes -- succeeding Veronique Nichanian after a 37-year tenure -- is scheduled for the upcoming January 19-24 Paris menswear week and is widely described as one of the most anticipated designer transitions of the season; coverage also notes she has hired designer John-Gabriel Harrison to her creative team ahead of the show. Separately, trade coverage confirms the fixed calendar dates for both the Paris menswear week and Haute Couture Spring/Summer 2027 (Jan 25-28), both falling just after this window closes. No garment, silhouette, or look content is reported this window, since no show has taken place yet -- this report logs confirmed pre-show facts (appointment, succession, schedule) rather than speculating about collection content ahead of time.

top_signals.name: Grace Wales Bonner's Hermes menswear debut (Jan 19-24, 2027) draws pre-show anticipation coverage
top_signals.evidence: Grace Wales Bonner was named creative director of Hermes menswear in 2025, succeeding Veronique Nichanian, fashion's longest-serving creative director after a 37-year run; Nichanian presented her final Hermes collection in January 2026. Wales Bonner's own debut collection is scheduled for the January 19-24, 2027 Paris menswear week -- inside the week immediately following this collection window. Trade press (WWD) reports she has hired longtime Lanvin designer John-Gabriel Harrison to her creative team ahead of the show, and multiple outlets independently frame the debut as among the most closely watched designer transitions of the season, given her label's established blend of European tailoring with Afro-Atlantic references and archival research.
